title: IKOB Aporometrica: data of the Utrecht paper runs (inputs, skims, runs and tables)
description: The inputs, travel-time skims, model runs and paper tables behind the paper "Either you can reach it or you cannot" (threshold-gate accessibility, Utrecht shared bicycles), computed with IKOB Aporometrica (https://github.com/Marrekoo/IKOB_Aporometrica). The archives unpack into a data folder of the software: the GTFS NL feed and OpenStreetMap extracts used for the skims, the CBS neighbourhood GeoPackage and the LISA municipal job table; the skim stores of the study area, the imputed jobs per buurt and sector, and car availability and PT fare spending per segment (weighted ODiN 2022-23 aggregates with their respondent counts); the run folders of the run plans paper/runs.toml and paper/perturbation.toml and the paper tables. MANIFEST.sha256 lists the SHA-256 of every file, the same hashes each run records in its run.json. README.md gives the steps.
notes: OpenStreetMap data and the skims derived from them: ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. GTFS NL: free to use; Stichting OpenGeo, 'Dutch integrated real-time transit data', https://gtfs.openov.nl/ (built from the open data of the transit agencies, which do not endorse this deposit). CBS Kerncijfers wijken en buurten: CC BY 4.0. LISA municipal data: LISA (https://www.lisa.nl/gratis-data/). Model outputs: CC BY 4.0. ODiN aggregates published with the author's approval; the ODiN microdata are not included (DANS).
